signals.title: Sreedarsh-MA/jarvis-core
signals.content: JARVIS personal AI assistant: agents, memory, tasks, tutor, academic study, GitHub automation, GUI/MCP surfaces. Python core + jcode coding agent.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; implementation ecosystem relevance. Final score: 87. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: Sreedarsh-MA/jarvis-core

JARVIS is a personal AI assistant built on a Python core with a dedicated coding agent (jcode). It supports multiple agents, persistent memory, task management, tutoring, academic research assistance, GitHub automation, and both GUI and MCP interfaces. The system aims to streamline personal productivity and software development workflows, though its performance and security depend on the underlying implementations and user configurations.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: Sreedarsh-MA/jarvis-core

JARVIS هو مساعد ذكي شخصي يعتمد على نواة بايثون مع وكيل برمجي مخصص (jcode). يدعم عدة وكلاء، ذاكرة مستمرة، إدارة مهام، توجيه تعليمي، مساعدة في البحث الأكاديمي، أتمتة GitHub، وواجهات GUI وMCP. يهدف النظام إلى تحسين الإنتاجية الشخصية وتبسيط عمليات تطوير البرمجيات، مع الإشارة إلى أن كفاءته وأمانه يعتمدان على التنفيذات وتكوينات المستخدم.

signals.title: adityasasidhar/browsercontrol
signals.content: MCP server that gives AI agents a real browser: annotated screenshots with numbered elements, so the agent clicks by number (Playwright, Set of Marks)
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 72. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: adityasasidhar/browsercontrol

Brief: The MCP server provides AI agents with a real browser interface via Playwright. It captures annotated screenshots where each UI element is assigned a numeric label. Agents interact by issuing click commands referencing these numbers. This approach enables precise, visual-driven automation while preserving a lightweight, scriptable environment. The system’s efficacy depends on accurate element detection and consistent UI rendering; variations in page layout may affect reliability.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: adityasasidhar/browsercontrol

الملخص: خادم MCP يزوِّد وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي بواجهة متصفح حقيقية عبر Playwright. يلتقط لقطات شاشة مشروحة حيث يُعطى كل عنصر واجهة رقمًا. يتفاعل الوكلاء بإصدار أوامر النقر باستخدام هذه الأرقام. يتيح هذا النهج أتمتة دقيقة مدفوعة بالمرئيات مع الحفاظ على بيئة خفيفة وقابلة للبرمجة. تعتمد فعالية النظام على دقة اكتشاف العناصر وثبات عرض واجهة المستخدم؛ قد تؤثر تغيّرات تخطيط الصفحات على موثوقيته.

signals.title: Shraddhameduri/agentdesk
signals.content: AgentDesk — a tool-calling AI support agent (FastAPI + React/TS) with human-in-the-loop approvals, RAG, SSE streaming, and an offline eval suite.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; retrieval/RAG relevance. Final score: 67. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: Shraddhameduri/agentdesk

AgentDesk is an open‑source AI support‑agent platform built with FastAPI and a React/TypeScript front‑end. It combines Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) with Server‑Sent Events (SSE) streaming for real‑time responses. Human‑in‑the‑loop approvals allow operators to review and intervene before replies are sent. The repository also includes an offline evaluation suite for benchmarking model performance. Current documentation is limited; further testing is needed to confirm scalability and security claims.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: Shraddhameduri/agentdesk

AgentDesk هو منصة مفتوحة المصدر لوكيل دعم ذكي تعتمد على FastAPI وواجهة React/TypeScript. تجمع بين الاسترجاع المعزز للجيل (RAG) وتدفق الأحداث عبر SSE لتوفير ردود فورية. تسمح آلية التدخل البشري للمشغلين بمراجعة الردود قبل إرسالها. يتضمن المستودع أيضاً مجموعة تقييم غير متصلة لاختبار أداء النموذج. الوثائق المتاحة محدودة، لذا يلزم مزيد من الاختبارات لتأكيد ادعاءات القابلية للتوسع والأمان.

signals.title: Volant Manticore expands Iran-linked cyber espionage from Cyprus to Saudi Arabia, targeting critical sectors - Industrial Cyber
signals.content: Volant Manticore expands Iran-linked cyber espionage from Cyprus to Saudi Arabia, targeting critical sectors - Industrial Cyber Industrial Cyber
signals.score_reason: monitored AI source. Final score: 63. Freshness: source age 0.44d.
signals.brief_en: Volant Manticore, a cyber‑espionage group linked to Iran, has expanded its operations from Cyprus to Saudi Arabia. According to Industrial Cyber, the group is targeting critical sectors such as energy, petrochemicals, telecommunications and government networks. The campaign appears to use custom malware and credential‑harvesting tools, leveraging phishing and supply‑chain compromises. While attribution to Iranian actors is supported by infrastructure overlap and code similarities, definitive state sponsorship remains unconfirmed. Organizations in the region are advised to strengthen network segmentation, enforce multi‑factor authentication, and monitor for indicators of compromise associated with Volant Manticore.

signals.title: @piotrkulpinski: Same here: all 12 of my sites run on one Hetzner box (€59/mo, 64 GB RAM). The scary part is the day it dies. Everything goes down at once, a
signals.content: Same here: all 12 of my sites run on one Hetzner box (€59/mo, 64 GB RAM). The scary part is the day it dies. Everything goes down at once, and backups only help if they can rebuild the whole thing. So today I tested it. I rented a fresh server by the hour and rebuilt everything on it from backups only. Production kept running the whole time. 36 minutes later all 12 sites were back up. The server cost €0.11. The test also found 4 things my backups were missing: – a network I'd created by hand on the server – the login my server uses to download app images – a database setting that doesn't end up in database dumps – two apps that connect to the live database while they build Any of these would've turned a 36-minute recovery into a long night of guessing. All fixed now. The server also backs up its own config every night, and I get an alert if that backup stops. If you run everything on one box too: – back up the server's config, not only the databases – do a real restore on a throwaway server and time it Better to find out now than mid-outage 😅
